plugin.name: DeepInfra
plugin.description: DeepInfra's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds DeepInfra to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from DeepInfra, so new models show up by themselves.
